transcript: Long, long ago in a really big city and in a corner of the building, a man and a woman just want to go to their destination and they both carry the same cases. And but suddenly in a corner, the man and the woman bumped into with each other and they just fold down. And since their cases are the same. They didn't pay attention to that so they just grab one and go to their destination. Oh, go to their home and maybe their office. But when the man around his office, he opened the case and found out that this case belongs to the woman. And when the woman went back to his home, She found to her home and she found out that the case belongs to them. So that's a mistake.
